source: ARCHITECTURE.md package map and layer ranks; each package owns its own read APIs

contract.role: frozen contract types, Protocols, codec (stdlib only)

hostio.role: capability-scoped host primitives: git read, snapshots, host state, integrity, confinement

agent.role: confined worker, supervisor, checkpoint, capture, proposers

effect.role: one whole-patch EffectAccount from sealed snapshots

gate.role: sole writer of the original target; journal; recovery

feedback.role: immutable FeedbackRecords, add-only FeedbackInput, post-landing probe

operator.role: operator host: CLI, coordinator, artifacts, presentation

allowed_notes.obligation: Architecture rule: obligation -> contract, hostio and the effect public API hlith.effect.api only
allowed_notes.feedback: Architecture rule: 'declared lower probe APIs' = hlith.effect.api + hlith.obligation.api (public APIs only); any other feedback -> L1..L4 edge is a violation
allowed_notes.operator_views: Architecture rule: operator views -> contract + presentation read APIs (hlith.operator.*) + hostio textsafe ONLY (pure text sanitization is the rendering safety function, L0); no other hostio, no engine layers
allowed_notes.operator: Architecture: operator host -> public APIs of L1-L5, contract, hostio; operator/ includes tui/** (views)

hlith.types.role: verdict/obligation types; becomes a contract re-export at step M1

hlith.events.role: run events (roots injected, no sandbox import: architecture section 3)

hlith.gitsafe.role: hardened git runner: READ side -> hostio.git_read, WRITE side -> gate (split pending)
